أنطرح (form VII)
# أَنْطَرِحُ (ʔanṭariḥu) /ʔan.tˤa.ri.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْطَرَحَ (inṭaraḥa)
# أَنْطَرِحَ (ʔanṭariḥa) /ʔan.tˤa.ri.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَرَحَ (inṭaraḥa)
# أَنْطَرِحْ (ʔanṭariḥ) /ʔan.tˤa.riħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْطَرَحَ (inṭaraḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
